INSERT INTO market_snapshot (instrument_id, last_price, pct_chg, volume, amount, turnover_rate, pe_ttm, pb, total_mv, circ_mv, source, fetched_at, data_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{s.instrumentId}, #{s.lastPrice}, #{s.pctChg}, #{s.volume}, #{s.amount}, #{s.turnoverRate}, #{s.peTtm}, #{s.pb}, #{s.totalMv}, #{s.circMv}, #{s.source}, #{s.fetchedAt}, 'ACCEPTED', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', 'now', 'localtime'))
